references.text: The likeness of not looking back when fleeing for one's life, as in the story of Lot's flight from Sodom.
The exhortation to leave and not turn back to retrieve belongings in haste.
A parallel event described by Jesus, where he warns against turning back to retrieve belongings during a flight.
The warning not to turn back to retrieve belongings, with reference to Lot's wife who looked back.
